tasks.title: Package skeleton and requirements
tasks.why_tier: Boilerplate with one obvious right answer.
tasks.brief: Create the app package. app/report.py must define load(path), total(rows) and weighted_total(rows) with the signatures in spec.md section 2; each raises NotImplementedError for now. Create an empty requirements.txt.

tasks.title: CSV loader
tasks.why_tier: One function, clear contract, the data shape is given in spec.md.
tasks.brief: Implement load(path) per spec.md section 2.1: one dict per CSV data line, value_gbp as float. A row that cannot be parsed raises ValueError naming the line number; it is never skipped silently.

tasks.title: Totals and stage weighting
tasks.why_tier: Carries the reconciliation rule and the F2 failure mode; a wrong default here is silent.
tasks.brief: Implement total(rows) and weighted_total(rows) per spec.md section 2.2. Stage probabilities come from the table in section 2.2. An unknown stage raises KeyError; it never defaults.
